subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should this timestamped-backup PR proceed only after it preserves or migrates existing `.bak.N` backups, or are maintainers willing to accept first-write deletion of legacy recovery slots?
rationale: Current code treats config backups as recovery and sensitive-data artifacts, so deleting shipped numeric backups or changing chmod coverage is an upgrade behavior decision that should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Require upgrade-safe migration
options.body: Keep the PR open but require preserving or converting legacy `.bak.N` files until retention is safely replenished, plus proof for fresh and upgrade paths.

options.title: Accept first-write cleanup
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept deletion of legacy numeric backups, but that should be documented as an upgrade behavior change before merge.

options.title: Pause in favor of a broader design
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the broader backup-directory design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20460 to own the naming change too.

recommendation.title: Require upgrade-safe migration
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but require preserving or converting legacy `.bak.N` files until retention is safely replenished, plus proof for fresh and upgrade paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config backup/recovery work and related issue review context make this the strongest available owner for the upgrade-behavior decision.
